title: Invoice exceptions
summary: Reads incoming invoices and flags duplicates, large amounts and new vendors for a person to check. It never pays.

inspiration.title: Invoice data extraction with LlamaParse and OpenAI

stages.title: Read invoices
stages.does: Lists recent invoices and reads each into structured fields, leaving out anything unclear.

stages.title: Check for exceptions
stages.does: Flags duplicates, amounts over the threshold and new vendors; AMOUNT is the amount_threshold setting.

stages.title: Learn
stages.does: Turns feedback on earlier runs into learning and proposals before the write.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py learn --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out learn

stages.title: Write
stages.does: Applies the run input under the write contract.
stages.command: python3 skills/routineos/scripts/routineos.py write --docs snapshot.json --run run.json --out batches

connectors.label: Invoice mailbox or folder
connectors.connect: Add a connector with read access to where invoices arrive.
